description: This PHP source file defines the KinesisVideoSignalingChannelsClient class, which extends AwsClient and provides methods for interacting with the Amazon Kinesis Video Signaling Channels service, including configuration retrieval and signaling methods.

classes.name: KinesisVideoSignalingChannelsClient
classes.description: A client class used to communicate with the Amazon Kinesis Video Signaling Channels service, providing methods such as getIceServerConfig and sendAlexaOfferToMaster.

methods.name: getIceServerConfig
methods.description: Retrieves the ICE server configuration required for establishing peer-to-peer connections.

methods.name: getIceServerConfigAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously retrieves the ICE server configuration for peer-to-peer connections.

methods.name: sendAlexaOfferToMaster
methods.description: Sends an Alexa offer to the master signaling channel, part of the signaling process for establishing media connections.

methods.name: sendAlexaOfferToMasterAsync
methods.description: Asynchronous version of sendAlexaOfferToMaster, to send an Alexa offer to the master signaling channel.
